actions.name: Jetstream Charge
actions.description: The mech can make a charge as a standard action while underwater this turn if it has a swim speed or as a full action at half its highest base frame speed.

actions.name: Jetstream Throw
actions.description: Increase the thrown property to thrown (80 feet) and add the penetrating special property for the next attack with this weapon.
